summary.zh: 用清单排查 Python 代码里的常见坏做法
summary.en: A checklist of common Python bad practices to avoid

description.zh: 汇总重试逻辑散落、可变默认参数、异常被吞掉等常见问题，作为代码审查和自查的对照清单。适合合并前审阅，或排查由不良写法引起的问题。
description.en: Lists common Python mistakes such as scattered retry logic, mutable defaults, and swallowed exceptions as a review checklist. Use it before merging code or when debugging odd behavior.
